query:
-- Fix Alabama: Tuberville IS up for re-election in 2026 (Class 2 seat, won in 2020)
-- Fix Alabama incumbent field and runoff candidates
UPDATE senate_races SET 
  incumbent = 'Tommy Tuberville',
  incumbent_retiring = 0,
  candidate1_name = 'Everett Wess',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Barry Moore',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  status = 'Primary Runoff',
  notes = 'R runoff: Barry Moore vs. Will Boyd (June 30). D nominee: Everett Wess (uncontested).'
WHERE state_code = 'AL';

-- Fix Montana: clarify incumbent field (this is the seat Jon Tester held, lost in 2024 to Tim Sheehy — Sheehy is the incumbent)
UPDATE senate_races SET
  incumbent = 'Tim Sheehy',
  incumbent_party = 'R',
  incumbent_retiring = 0
WHERE state_code = 'MT';

-- Fix called_winner to only show the primary winner, not both
UPDATE senate_races SET called_winner = 'Josh Turek (D), Ashley Hinson (R)' WHERE state_code = 'IA';
UPDATE senate_races SET called_winner = 'Alani Bankhead (D), Kurt Alme (R)' WHERE state_code = 'MT';
UPDATE senate_races SET called_winner = 'Cory Booker (D), Justin Murphy (R)' WHERE state_code = 'NJ';
UPDATE senate_races SET called_winner = 'Ben Ray Luján (D)' WHERE state_code = 'NM';
UPDATE senate_races SET called_winner = 'Julian Beaudion (D), Mike Rounds (R)' WHERE state_code = 'SD';
